svg.title: The gate a model pipeline is missing
svg.desc: A nine-gate CI pipeline drawn left to right with each gate's duration underneath and a dashed parallel track carrying two concurrent jobs that rejoin before deploy, cutting the critical path from 4m42s to 3m03s; the fourth gate is drawn heavier and circled as a model quality check, shown twice as a tilting balance comparing a committed baseline of 0.938 against builds of 0.931, which passes, and 0.918, which fails, plus a crossed-out long-lived secret replaced by OIDC and a rollback arrow to a previous image digest.
svg.text: The gate a model pipeline is missing
code has tests. Models usually have NOTHING
between the training run and production. This
one gate is the whole module.
roll back to the previous DIGEST
a tag can move. A digest cannot.
...and how do you gate an LLM? -> Week 31
